name: Mattithiah
overview: Mattithiah was a male Levite who held the important role of a second rank gatekeeper, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 15:18. His service as a gatekeeper highlights his responsibility in the sacred duties associated with the tabernacle or temple. No additional personal notes are provided about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Mattithiah means 'gift of YHWH,' reflecting a recognition of divine blessing. This proper name appears in 1 Chronicles 15:18 and emphasizes the spiritual significance of his identity as one given by God’s gift.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Mattithiah as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe entrusted with temple service. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are recorded.
scriptureSignificance: Mattithiah’s role as a second rank Levite gatekeeper places him within the vital structure of temple service, ensuring the proper functioning and sanctity of worship in Israel. His mention in 1 Chronicles 15:18 situates him among those who supported King David’s efforts to organize the tabernacle and its worship. This service reflects the faithfulness of the Levites in their God-ordained duties during a pivotal time in Israel’s history.
